# uptimekuma_notification_kook (Resource)

Kook notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_kook" "example" {
  name       = "Kook Notifications"
  bot_token  = "1/MzAxMjk5NzA1OTMzMDAwMA=="
  guild_id   = "382941547624206336"
  is_default = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_kook" "alerts" {
  name       = "Kook Alerts"
  bot_token  = "1/MzAxMjk5NzA1OTMzMDAwMA=="
  guild_id   = "382941547624206337"
  is_default = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: bot_token_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change bot_token_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_kook" "write_only" {
  name     = "Kook with write-only bot token"
  guild_id = "382941547624206338"

  bot_token_wo         = "1/MzAxMjk5NzA1OTMzMDAwMA=="
  bot_token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guild_id` (String) Kook guild/server ID where messages will be sent
- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `bot_token` (String, Sensitive) Kook bot token for authentication. Stored in state; use `bot_token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `bot_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Kook bot token for authentication, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `bot_token`; requires `bot_token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `bot_token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `bot_token` until the next apply with `bot_token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `bot_token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `bot_token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `bot_token_wo`.
- `is_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
